requirements.evidence: Contract is essentially all present: Queues component/props/methods and render data (app/Livewire/Entity/Queues.php:32-226), Serve component (app/Livewire/Entity/Serve.php:25-95), Routes entity.queues/entity.serve (routes/web.php:59-60), members tabs (resources/views/livewire/entity/members.blade.php:6-20), navbar links (@can view/update in resources/views/layouts/default-page.blade.php:44-48), and all required lang keys in lang/en/ui.php and lang/pt_BR/ui.php. Gaps: not every interactive control has an aria-label (resources/views/livewire/entity/queues.blade.php:47,78,113,156) and priority is hidden for zero-priority tickets (resources/views/livewire/entity/serve.blade.php:53-54).

conventions.evidence: Uses #[Validate] for name/renameName (app/Livewire/Entity/Queues.php:32,53), domain actions instead of inline writes (Queues.php:92,141,178,231; Serve.php:70-74), policies for authorization, entity-scoped Eloquent reads, and the existing x-label/x-input components (resources/views/livewire/entity/queues.blade.php:39-47); docs/business-rules.md and CHANGELOG.md were updated. Deviations: Serve validates mode with an inline $this->validate([...]) (app/Livewire/Entity/Serve.php:70) instead of the project's #[Validate] pattern, and mode/selectedQueueId/activeTab remain plain client-writable public properties (Serve.php:41-42, app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:55).

security.evidence: Every client id is resolved through entity relations before use: $this->entity->queues()->findOrFail (app/Livewire/Entity/Queues.php:108,113,141,178,187,231) and $this->entity->queues()->find (Serve.php:61,127); membership ids via $this->entity->memberships()->findOrFail (Queues.php:234). Server context is #[Locked] (Queues.php:27, Serve.php:22,46). A tampered accessQueueId yields accessQueue=null and empty accessGrants (Queues.php:212-219). Output uses {{ }}, never {!! !!}, and tests cover foreign ids, demotion, tamper and 403 paths.

tests.evidence: Large Pest coverage: tests/Feature/Entity/QueuesTest.php (create, duplicate slug, rename slug re-derivation, confirmation modal, access grant/revoke with audit, foreign ids, demoted manager), tests/Feature/Entity/ServeTest.php (selection, ordering/mode/limit, exceptions, foreign queue, 403, locked lastCalledTicketId, rate limit), plus members-tab and navbar tests. Gaps: no happy-path test for an employee holding a call grant actually calling next (only the no-grant 403 case), and the duplicate-slug message mapping is not asserted, only assertHasErrors('name').

simplicity.evidence: Reuses the existing actions, policy and Blade components and adds no service/repository layer (app/Livewire/Entity/Queues.php:92-93,231; resources/views/livewire/entity/queues.blade.php:39-47). Minor duplication: render performs three separate entity->queues() lookups (Queues.php:212-219) and CallMode::tryFrom($this->mode) is evaluated twice per query chain (Serve.php:139-140).

readability.evidence: Methods are small and documented with clear names (app/Livewire/Entity/Queues.php:63-100, app/Livewire/Entity/Serve.php:58-95), and the Blade follows the sibling members page. Weak spot: domainError() decides the message solely from whether a 'slug' error key exists (Queues.php:278-284), a brittle heuristic whose message text no test pins down.

scope.evidence: The diff only touches the queues/serve/members UI, their routes, navbar, both locale files, docs/business-rules.md, CHANGELOG.md and the related tests (change.diff). No unrelated refactors or out-of-scope features.

issues.explanation: The task requires aria-labels on interactive controls, but the create/rename section cancel buttons, the toggle-modal cancel button and the access-modal close button rely on visible text only.
The waiting list must show the ticket priority, but the priority tag is rendered only when priority > 0, so normal tickets show no priority at all.

mode is validated with an inline rules array only inside callNext() rather than #[Validate], and waitingTickets() reads it through CallMode::tryFrom() where an invalid value silently means 'no filter' instead of being rejected.
toggleActive() is the only mutating action that does not call $this->authorize() itself; it relies on UpdateQueue plus the hydrate() manager check, which is inconsistent with every sibling action.

activeTab and selectedQueueId are client-writable public properties without #[Locked] or attribute validation, so setActiveTab()'s whitelist can be bypassed by setting the property directly through the Livewire payload.
Only the no-grant 403 path is tested; there is no test proving an employee who holds a call grant can actually list the queue and call the next ticket.
render() re-queries entity->queues() three times and CallMode::tryFrom($this->mode) is computed twice in the same query building, both easily collapsed into one expression each.
domainError() infers a duplicate-slug failure from the presence of a 'slug' key and otherwise shows the generic name message, which is fragile and not covered by an assertion on the actual text.

review.summary: Adds the owner/admin queues page, the attendant serve panel, members tabs, navbar links and both locales' strings, all built on the existing domain actions and policies. The change is functionally complete and security-conscious (entity-scoped id resolution, locked server state, tamper and 403 tests); the remaining gaps are minor: incomplete aria-labels, priority hidden for normal tickets, mode/tab properties not following the #[Validate] pattern, and a few untested edge cases.
